text:
Marco Silva: FYI Connexus (acct ..7720) had a card authorization blocked by the bank this morning. invoices C-7340 and C-7341 bounced.
Jin Park: decline code? bank message?
billing-bot: alert: payment_method=card_last4=7720 status=declined code=transaction_blocked attempts=1 note=bank_blocked_for_suspected_fraud
CS-Nina: i called their AP. bank blocked the charge; AP is on it and asked if we can accept a same-day wire instead. they said it should clear within 24h.
Marco Silva: ok run a single auto-retry in 2h only if AP confirms updated payment method. otherwise pause retries. hold dunning emails for 24h while AP fixes the bank block.
AR-Hugo: please request remittance instructions and proof of wire when they send funds. also ask for SWIFT/ABA and intermediary bank if international. do not paste full account numbers in slack.
CS-Nina: emailed customer our wire template and asked for expected settlement ETA. pasted template (no acct):
```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Inc.
Bank: First Partner Bank
Routing/SWIFT: [provide]
Intermediary bank: [if applicable]
Reference: Connexus + invoice numbers
Amount: USD XXXX
```
CS-Nina: they replied: "we will wire today; bank needs beneficiary address and SWIFT full name. attaching their payment team's note."
Marco Silva: ok send beneficiary address via secure support channel, not slack. ask CS to request remittance email with invoice numbers and amounts.
Jin Park: set invoices to pending_wire. threshold for service hold is 75k; Connexus outstanding ~18k so no hold.
billing-bot: action logged: set_status=pending_wire ticket=AR-4412 scheduled_check=1774087634
AR-Hugo: once proof arrives, apply funds to the oldest invoice first and attach remittance to AR-4412. if wire hasn't landed in 48h escalate to AR lead.
CS-Nina: uploaded the customer's payment_note.pdf to the ticket and confirmed they'll initiate EOD.
Marco Silva: thanks. one more: if customer asks for temporary credit to avoid service interruption, we only do that with VP approval for amounts >10k. note Connexus current balance ~18k. i'll loop in VP if they ask.
CS-Nina: client asked about partial payment until wire clears. i told them we'll check with finance and get back.
Jin Park: fine. if they send partial via card update, accept and reconcile; otherwise wait for wire. set follow-up reminder 1774005940 (~4h).
Marco Silva: closing for now: automated retry paused, manual follow-up in place, ticket AR-4412 open. thanks all :thumbsup:
